decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 14.1 The proposed roof extension by reason of its height, bulk and position would be out of character and overdominant within the streetscene and would adversely affect the setting of the proposed Spring Grove Conservation Area. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and ENV 1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV- B.2.2 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - 14.2 The proposed roof extension would lead to a significant loss of light to surrounding occupiers of residential properties contrary to Policy ENV.1.1 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policy ENV-B.1.1 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 3 - The additional parking spaces lead to a poor parking layout and exceed the maximum parking standards leading to a reduction in highway safety and an increased reliance on use of the private car contrary to Policies T.2.5, T.4.4 and T.1.7 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies T.1.14, T.4.4 and T.1.2 and Appendix 4 of the Proposed alterations revised deposit (2001) UDP.
description: Erection of a fourth storey to office building and refurbishment of exterior and entrance
